displayName: E13 retention sweep has not run

documentation.content:
The nightly `ledger-purge` job has not logged a completed sweep in 36 hours.

Database rows have no bucket lifecycle rule, so E13's retention is enforced by this cron and nothing else — a stopped sweep means data is kept past the period the privacy notice promises.

36h rather than 24h so one late run is not a page.

**A threshold condition, not `conditionAbsent`** — the absent form is capped at 23h30m by the API, which would have paged on a single late run. `evaluationMissingData: ACTIVE` is what makes it fire on silence; without it a metric with no data points simply never evaluates, and the alert would be decorative.

See `docs/runbook.md` § *Retenção de dados (E13)*. Check `gcloud run jobs executions list --job ledger-purge` first; the Scheduler reports success as soon as the execution is *created*, so its green tick proves nothing.

**How the 36h is built.** The API caps an alignment period at 25h and a `conditionAbsent` duration at 23h30m, so neither expresses 36h on its own. This is a 25h trailing sum that must stay below 1 for a further 11.5h — silence since the last sweep of about 36.5h. `evaluationMissingData: ACTIVE` is what makes it fire on silence at all; without it a metric with no data points never evaluates and the alert would be decorative.

The filter pins `resource.type="cloud_run_job"` — the API requires a resource restriction, and this is the right one: it watches the *scheduled* sweep specifically. A hand-run sweep from a laptop logs under a different resource and deliberately does not silence this alert.
